# HarvestFlow

> HarvestFlow is church follow-up software for churches worldwide. It helps a church follow up every new convert and first-time visitor, assign each person to a worker, record every call and visit, and track discipleship from the altar call to active membership. It is free for churches during the beta. Tagline: "Sow the seed. Track the growth."

HarvestFlow is a web app (app.harvestflows.com) that works on phones and computers, including offline for field workers. It is built and maintained by Adeniyi Owolabi, a developer and church leader. Churches register at https://www.harvestflows.com/ and receive a login link by email.

## What it does

- [Church convert tracking](https://www.harvestflows.com/church-convert-tracking-software): register converts at outreaches and crusades (including by voice), assign each to a follow-up worker, and see who has been reached.
- [New convert follow-up](https://www.harvestflows.com/new-convert-follow-up): one-tap calls, recorded outcomes, discipleship milestones and next steps for each person.
- [First-time visitor follow-up](https://www.harvestflows.com/first-time-visitor-follow-up): QR self check-in with "First time here?", a welcome message sequence for visitors who agree to it, and a welcomer for each visitor.
- Membership: a member directory (contact details, birthday, marital status, occupation, joining date), membership stages (new, full, inactive, relocated), children linked to a parent, and one-tap promotion of a settled convert to a member. Members can be imported from a CSV file.
- [Cell groups and attendance](https://www.harvestflows.com/cell-group-management-software): members, cell groups, departments, one attendance register per service, and pastoral care tasks for people who miss services.
- [WhatsApp follow-up](https://www.harvestflows.com/church-whatsapp-follow-up): send updates and reminders by WhatsApp, with SMS as an option in countries the messaging provider covers.
- [Discipleship tracking](https://www.harvestflows.com/discipleship-tracking-software): milestones such as first attendance, cell group and water baptism, with reports for church leaders.
- [All features](https://www.harvestflows.com/features)

## Pricing

Free for churches during the beta. Future pricing will be announced before the beta ends.
